# User Workshop Notes

## Advisors

Advisors start from saved queue searches rather than the application home
page. They use keyboard actions to assign themselves a case, add a standard
note, and move to the next item.

Several teams keep local text templates for common responses. These templates
are not managed in Case Ledger.

Advisors said a closed case can be reopened when a requester provides new
information. They disagreed on whether reopening should preserve the previous
closure reason.

## Supervisors

Supervisors need to identify unassigned, aging, and high-priority cases. They
also move work between teams when staffing changes.

One supervisor relies on a daily spreadsheet export that is not mentioned in
the user guide. Another uses the weekly reporting pack.

## Administrators

Administrators maintain categories, closure reasons, appointment types, and
team membership. Some values cannot be removed because older cases reference
them.

## Adoption

Users expect keyboard-efficient handling and familiar queue concepts.
Training capacity and local workflow variations have not been assessed.
